# tsk

> tsk is a terminal task board for you and your agents: one shared queue, a TUI for you, a CLI for them.

Install with `curl -fsSL https://gettsk.sh/install.sh | sh` or `brew install smarzban/tap/tsk`.
If Herdr is on PATH, the curl installer asks to run `tsk setup herdr` on a TTY; when agent skill roots are detected it also asks once to install the tsk skill. The install ends with a single `Done.` line pointing at the board (plus the Herdr board shortcut after an accepted Herdr setup) and one row per skipped ask (`tsk setup herdr`, `tsk setup`); a custom `TSK_INSTALL_DIR` skips the asks and says so. Homebrew prints the Herdr setup command as a caveat.
Herdr's board shortcut opens or focuses one board per workspace across its tabs, preserving its view and edits. Other workspaces stay untouched; boards share the same task store.
Details: https://gettsk.sh/docs/install.md
Inside Git, the repo root is the default project. Outside Git, tsk opens and captures on the desk while keeping the current directory available as a project.
New tasks start with status `open` in the board's inbox, below picked `ready` tasks. Use the ready and open board commands to move them between groups, and `tsk list --open` or `--ready` to filter. The board checks GitHub releases at most daily and shows a dim `vX.Y.Z available, run tsk update` on the status row; set `TSK_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` to disable. Run `tsk update` to immediately run the official installer for an installer-managed copy; Homebrew copies print `brew update && brew upgrade tsk` instead.
`N` tasks on the desk are human-only notices: four starter tasks on a first open, one `What's new in tsk` task after an upgrade. `tsk list` never shows them.
At 110 usable columns or wider, clicking a task opens or updates its details beside the board with board focus; double-click opens it full screen. Store format v4 migrates v3 ready tasks to open on first save and keeps a `tsk.json.v3` backup. On Projects Overview, clicking or moving the index selection opens the cursored project's preview beside the index at Split, then a live narrow project board at Rail, never a full-screen task. The right board names the selected project in its top row, owns its own selection and actions; expanding quick-add there keeps the draft title in that header while Notes is active; Esc returns to the index. Narrow panes use click-to-peek.

## For agents

- `tsk guide` prints the workflow; `tsk setup` detects agents and can install the skill; `tsk setup <agent>` targets one agent
- `tsk list T<n>` returns the complete task, including notes, steps, and thread, in human-readable or JSON form
- Guide: https://gettsk.sh/docs/agents.md
- CLI: https://gettsk.sh/docs/cli.md
- `tsk help [<command>]` prints the CLI or one command's syntax reference.
- `tsk --version` (or `tsk -V`) prints the installed version.

Storage, backups, and release-check settings: https://gettsk.sh/docs/storage.md
- Full docs: https://gettsk.sh/llms-full.txt
